cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: cite the initiating component, message and run from viewed evidence within 12 simulated minutes, using at most one full rerun and retaining the initiating record.
cards.burden: Instantiate paired synthetic repetitions and log each action. Both initial arms pay four execution minutes plus one view minute; later requests and actions must also be charged. A tabletop policy must be specified before exercise. This establishes only bounded policy behavior.
cards.construction: Reset each repetition to completed run-1. Hold one full rerun fixed, producing run-2 and retaining run-1. Independently assign run-2 tail or full inspection. Keep diagnosis demand, policy, concealed scoring and budget identical. Require a component/message/run commitment from records actually inspected before scoring.
cards.defeat: The proposed visibility-mediated decision mechanism lacks support if matched full and tail views produce unchanged following actions. Its outcome prediction fails if the full-view arm cannot commit a supported diagnosis within budget, exceeds one full rerun, or loses initiating evidence. A correct fixture-answer guess is invalid.
cards.mutation: Hypothesis: change the generation-to-inspection handoff from default newest-run tail to explicitly selected full view while preserving both operations. Root visibility may interrupt a subsequent rerun demand; the stipulated selection reset alone proves no decision loop.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: after full inspection the policy will commit B2, CONFIG missing region, run-2, line 8 from viewed evidence and request fewer subsequent full reruns than after tail inspection. The initial full-view route costs five action minutes; success remains unobserved.
cards.prediction_rival: Hypothesis: a visibility-independent policy will make the same next request in both arms, even when line 8 is visible. Tail-only evidence cannot support the initiating message citation, although either arm may subsequently inspect retained evidence.
cards.probe: Run matched tail/full repetitions and record M1-M5: charged times, full-rerun counts, selected intervals, initiating visibility, following requests, committed citations and retained history. Record requests before executing them. Compare following actions and scored commitments; any second full rerun already fails the outcome. Add covered negative full-log repetitions with line 8 replaced by progress to detect answer guessing, without counting them as successful root diagnosis.
cards.rival: Hypothesis: the selected policy reruns for reasons independent of visible initiating evidence; exposing line 8 may improve citation support without changing rerun demand.
unknowns: No exercised policy or successful commitment is observed; O5 supplies actions without their causes.
Blinding within this packet is procedural and may fail.
Commitment effort and real analyst timing are unavailable; nondeterministic or changing failures may behave differently.

cards.anchor: Hypothesized outcome: diagnose the unchanged synthetic initiating failure from retained evidence within 12 simulated minutes with zero new full reruns, preserving its record.
cards.burden: Use separate resets and the same diagnosis rule. Charge one minute for retained full inspection versus four execution plus one inspection minute for the fresh-full comparison. Log commitment separately because its cost is unspecified. No live CI or real timing is needed.
cards.construction: Reset to completed run-1. In the attack arm prohibit fresh full-suite execution and explicitly inspect retained run-1 in full. In the comparison arm execute exactly one full rerun and inspect run-2 in full. A complementary tail assignment in each execution condition distinguishes visibility from execution. Require actual viewed evidence and commitment before scoring in all arms.
cards.defeat: The retained-evidence outcome fails if no supported initiating citation is committed within budget or its record is lost. If the fresh-full arm succeeds while retained-full does not, identify the indispensable missing context before attributing the difference to execution. Unsupported B2 answers, especially on negative full logs, cannot refute necessity.
cards.mutation: Hypothesis: remove the preferred fresh-full-execution requirement and use named retained full inspection as the evidence-acquisition step. Cross execution condition with view instead of treating a rerun and its default tail as one inseparable action.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: retained-full inspection supports commitment of B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 after one stipulated view minute with zero full reruns. Fresh-full inspection supplies the same stipulated initiating message under a new run identity and costs five action minutes. Only an actual scored commitment demonstrates the candidate outcome.
cards.prediction_rival: Hypothesis: fresh execution is indispensable, so retained-full inspection cannot yield a valid initiating diagnosis despite line 8 being viewed, while fresh-full inspection can. The rival must specify necessary context absent from retained evidence; the unchanged log recipe stipulates no such extra information.
cards.probe: Exercise the crossed no-rerun/full-rerun and tail/full conditions with identical starting history, budget and diagnosis demand. Compare supported commitments, requested next actions and record retention. Include covered negative full logs to detect fixture-answer guessing. A supported retained-full commitment contradicts fresh-execution necessity only within this deterministic fixture; next-action differences separately test visibility mediation.
cards.rival: Hypothesis: a fresh full-suite run supplies indispensable diagnostic context beyond retained evidence, rather than visibility explaining any difference.
unknowns: The exercise has not been performed; no successful future or human productivity benefit is observed.
Following actions depend on the specified policy, and within-packet concealment is not guaranteed.
Focused B7 names a B2 prerequisite but omits its configuration message; it cannot independently support that message citation.
Real rerun motives, cognitive effort and generalization to changing or multiple-root failures remain unknown.
